look_here_first: Differentiate late boneset from white mistflower/white snakeroot by its tall branched HERBACEOUS form, narrower opposite lanceolate gland-dotted leaves (usually 20–90+ × 5–40 mm), and 9–15 florets per capitulum. FNA describes 8–12 phyllaries in 1–2 series, each usually 1–3 mm long.

key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Opposite, coarsely serrate, petiolate, often with scattered glands.

key_traits.label: Heads
key_traits.text: Small white discoid heads in broad corymbs/panicles.

key_traits.label: Reproductive confirmation
key_traits.text: FNA: 9–15 disk florets per capitulum; 8–12 phyllaries in 1–2 series, usually 1–3 mm, compared with genus-specific Ageratina and Chromolaena architecture.
